entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I think I need to return something? I bought some spin class shoes a while back, and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into that. To get started, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number VF77891. It's just... the website was a little overwhelming. I'm not sure if I'm even allowed to return them.

Thank you, Sarah. I have your order right here for the cycling shoes. I can definitely clarify the return options for you. First, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, I guess it's preference? They just don't feel right. I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels every time I use them. The cleats seem fine, they clip in and out, but the fit is just awful for me.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you blisters, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I'm just pulling up our policy guidelines for you.
I tried reading it online, but I saw one thing that said 20 days, and another page said something else entirely... I just got lost. Can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.

Of course, I can absolutely help with that. There's no need to worry. Let me see... your order was delivered 67 days ago. According to our policy, standard items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe to send them back.
Oh, really? So it's not a problem? I can get a refund?

That's correct. Since you're within the 90-day window, you are eligible for a full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return in our system and I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email address on file right now.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
